## Checklist

- [ ] Findings: refreshed main, matched QIDs/authors, removed duplicates; only a new CSV and optional note

- [ ] No keys, tokens, `.env` files or personal data (`npm run check:secrets`)
- [ ] Code changes: `npm run build && npm test` pass
- [ ] UI changes: strings in EN/PL/RU/ES and a phone screenshot
- [ ] Stored data: only added fields, or a migration step with a test (docs/data-and-sync.md)
